synthesis.transcript: Caesar does not assault the hill. He encircles it. Rampart, ditch and timber tower, built while under attack. In front of it: trenches, a channel flooded from the rivers, rows of sharpened branches, pits with fire-hardened stakes at the bottom, iron hooks set in blocks and buried in the ground. The legionaries called the pits lilies. These are not soldiers who can dig. They are engineers who happen to fight.
